sections.content: Recommendations about cities often use expressions such as es *necesario* *que*, es *importante* que and *recomiendo* que followed by the present subjunctive. The structure lets speakers propose an action without presenting it as an established fact.

items.spanish: Es necesario que la ciudad reduzca el tráfico.
items.english: It is necessary for the city to reduce traffic.

items.spanish: Recomiendo que mejoren las aceras para los peatones.
items.english: I recommend that they improve the pavements for pedestrians.

items.spanish: Es importante que haya más espacios públicos.
items.english: It is important that there are more public spaces.

items.spanish: Propongo que el ayuntamiento cree una zona sin coches.
items.english: I propose that the city council create a car-free area.

sections.content: When the recommendation has a different subject from the person making it, use *que* + subjunctive: *recomiendo* que *mejoren*..., es *importante* que *haya*....
